allthetweaks.valhelsia_core.cosmeticsWar: Valhelsia Team is selling Capes, violating Commercial Usage Guidelines!
allthetweaks.valhelsia_core.dontbuyCosme: Until this ends, ALL Valhelsia cosmetic features will be disabled in ATM ModPacks.
allthetweaks.configuration.pack.tooltip: Identity of this pack: the name it shows under, its links, and its Discord presence.
allthetweaks.configuration.discord.toolt: Which Discord application the Rich Presence is published under.
allthetweaks.configuration.pack.display_: Shown in the window title and on the main menu branding lines. Blank takes it from the packmode profile.
allthetweaks.configuration.pack.cursefor: Opened by the CurseForge button on the Discord Rich Presence card. Blank means no button.
The Discord application the presence is published under. Its name and uploaded art are what players see on the card, so a pack with its own branding needs its own application. Zero takes it from the packmode profile.
Main image on the presence card. Accepts an asset key uploaded to the Discord application or a public image URL. An unknown key falls back to the application's own icon.
Small icon drawn over the corner of the large image. Accepts an asset key from the Discord application or a public image URL. Blank means no corner icon.
Lines shown instead of Main Menu while the player sits in the menu. One is picked at random and swapped for another every minute.
allthetweaks.configuration.pack.window.i: File name inside the allthetweaks config folder. Leave blank to use the bundled icon.
File name inside the allthetweaks config folder. Leave blank to use the bundled icon.
allthetweaks.configuration.rpc_enabled.t: Publish this pack as your Discord activity. Takes effect without restarting.
